title: EIP-8200: EVMification
description: Replace the RIPEMD-160, MODEXP, and BLAKE2f precompiles with equivalent EVM bytecode
author: Kevaundray Wedderburn (@kevaundray)
laymanDescription: Three of Ethereum's built-in cryptographic helpers are hand-written into every client, and each one is a place where implementations can quietly disagree. This proposal replaces them with ordinary EVM bytecode deployed at the same addresses, so contracts calling them keep working unchanged.
benefits: Removes three hand-written implementations every client must maintain and keep identical
Lowers the barrier for zkEVMs, which need a separate optimized version of each precompile
Contracts keep calling the same addresses, so nothing needs redeploying
tradeoffs: Gas costs change, and modular exponentiation is expected to cost more for large inputs
Contracts passing a fixed gas amount to these addresses may start reverting
The replacement bytecode must be audited to match the precompile on every input
